drivers/misc/uid_sys_stats.c.rationale: Reviewed entire added implementation and full normalized-ACK delta. Retain per-UID CPU/IO snapshots and foreground/background controls: pinned KernelCpuUidTimeReader and StoragedUidIoStatsReader consume these exact proc formats; system_server has SELinux write rules and genfs labels. Existing 0444 read/0222 write modes are retained for Android policy compatibility and require SELinux for intended access isolation. 643c4957dc48 validates range endpoints and replaces unbounded integer enumeration with one pass over 1024 buckets plus stored entries, rescheduling between buckets; this prevents range-size CPU exhaustion and signed-long wrap. Host checks execute the actual function with a hash shim under ASan/UBSan, including UINT_MAX/full-range and malformed bounds. UID data/worker locking and copied exit statistics avoid task-pointer lifetime dependence; failed allocation or a deferred update whose UID entry was removed/missing can lose statistics. Counters are observational, not security/resource limits; namespace attribution and concurrent snapshots are not runtime-certified. Final ACK reverted fsync syscall tracking, leaving those format columns zero. Runtime OEM fields have actual hook consumers; no KMI padding retained.

drivers/misc/Kconfig.rationale: Full net delta retains only UID_SYS_STATS, requiring PROFILING and TASK_IO_ACCOUNTING; both satisfy the current Android statistics build. c81b372de983 removes dangling PKVM_SMC_FILTER and PKVM_IOMMU_TEMPLATE entries, which explicitly require ARM64 and describe templates. Their directories are already absent from this x86 SDK port. Native LTS misc options remain. This scoped exclusion does not assess shared generic virtualization paths.

drivers/misc/Makefile.rationale: Full net delta retains only UID_SYS_STATS object selection. c81b372de983 removes two dangling build paths for explicitly ARM64-only hypervisor template directories already omitted from SDK. Native LTS misc objects remain unchanged.

mm/pgsize_migration.c.rationale: Reviewed the entire added file and full normalized-ACK residual. Retain default-enabled 4 KiB/64-bit ELF padding and root-writable sysfs switch, positively consumed by pinned bionic linker_phdr.cpp MADV_DONTNEED padding hints. Hints require a private file-backed .so, ELF magic, bounded trailing range and linker context. Final ACK 099fe093d60d uses try/read VMA lookup rather than acquiring mmap_lock beneath a VMA read lock; rejection only omits a hint. The path check is a reporting heuristic, not authentication. aa723abf2d05 atomically replaces padding bits and validates field/VMA bounds, preventing count combination and loss of native VM_MAYBE_GUARD. Splits reconstruct original bounds from both halves and redistribute suffix padding; merging padded VMAs is rejected. Synthetic display copies remove file/protection/padding bits and cannot recurse. Native LTS has no corresponding subsystem. Retain ACK wholly-padded-VMA and split-calculation fixes. Extracted-code ASan/UBSan checks cover forced interleavings and 14962 splits. Other callers/proc locking remain separate reviews; no kernel concurrency or runtime verification claimed. See SECURITY.md and evidence/padding-flags-check.json.

include/linux/pgsize_migration.h.rationale: Reviewed the full new header. Retain padding interfaces, disabled-mode stubs for non-4KiB/non-64-bit kernels and bounded SELFMAG kernel_read checking for ELF hints. Native LTS has no corresponding interface. The implementation and pinned Bionic linker padding consumer justify retention. No historical KMI layout or override of LTS permission checks. c476769367dd adds native printk rate limiting for invalid padding-hint diagnostics reachable from unprivileged madvise; checks and return behavior are unchanged.

include/linux/pgsize_migration_inline.h.rationale: Reviewed the full new header and native vm_flags consumers. Four functional high bits encode at most 15 base pages (60 KiB) of ELF padding; bit 63 remains native mseal. Native VM_MAYBE_GUARD bit 11 is preserved by aa723abf2d05 atomic updates. vma_pad_fixup_flags preserves current padding when caller flags carry it; VMA writers retain native serialization. VMA_PAD_START uses the bounded implementation accessor. This is Bionic alignment metadata, not historical ABI padding. The 64 KiB ELF segment alignment bound is separate from the maximum emulated kernel page size of 16 KiB.

mm/page_size_compat.c.rationale: Reviewed the entire added implementation and normalized-ACK residual. Retain positive Goldfish page_shift=14 support. dbae496171a5 validates a temporary before publishing the boot parameter and caps it at the actual x86 vDSO maximum of 16 KiB. Keep read-only-after-init shift and GPL source exports. ASLR random-page bit counts decrease by the page-shift difference while x86 arch_rnd shifts by the emulated size: the byte span is preserved, with two fewer placement bits in 16 KiB mode; this explicit security tradeoff is documented in SECURITY.md. Native 4 KiB behavior remains. BPF ring-file classification checks the real bpf_map_fops and ring map type, matching local libbpf ringbuf.c getpagesize-based offsets. Perf mlock allowance retains 512 KiB plus one emulated metadata page. c0cbe76ff03a moves swap translation into the native swapfile validation/ownership path using a private copy; no stale cache-rewriting helper remains. Extracted parser and swap checks cover adaptations; other mapping/BPF/perf consumers are separately reviewed. No whole-feature runtime claim.

include/linux/page_size_compat.h.rationale: Reviewed the full final helper header. Retain emulated alignment/logging, extra-alignment space, BPF ring offset scaling and cachestat count conversion. Native mode leaves alignment/counts unchanged. Ring offsets divide only for recognized ring-map files with aligned positive offsets; matching libbpf maps at getpagesize(). d65b1b963b41 eliminates the pread-specific pagemap declaration; c0cbe76ff03a removes the cache-rewriting swap helper declaration. c476769367dd uses native rate-limited printk for diagnostics reachable by unprivileged invalid requests. Maximum supported emulation is now accurately documented as 16 KiB. These are functional source interfaces, not historical KMI shims; full consumer integrations remain separate reviews.

include/linux/page_size_compat_defs.h.rationale: Reviewed the entire definitions header and x86 vDSO layout consumers. Retain __MAX_PAGE_SHIFT=14 and assembly-safe size/mask constants, runtime __page_shift restricted to CONFIG_X86_64, static-key disabled native defaults, alignment helpers and rounded page-count conversion. The header split supplies assembly/minimal-dependency consumers; retaining it is not a historical ABI-layout requirement despite the original comment mentioning KABI. Pinned Goldfish explicitly enables page_shift=14. No ARM or future-platform emulation is added.

mm/swapfile.c.rationale: Reviewed full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas plus allocation, device reference, free, activation and teardown paths. Retain generic swap source exports and Android policy/observation callbacks for vendor customization; no-hook behavior remains native. Callbacks run under existing local/spin locks where applicable, must not sleep, and are trusted code; entry/flag mutations must honor allocator accounting contracts. Exact optional SDK callback use is unresolved and conservatively retained. c0cbe76ff03a translates Android Toybox/mmd/fs_mgr emulated swap formats without cached-header mutation, preserving native validation and capacity bounds, and reserves the entire header in map and clusters. d7f2fd2bd53e stores activation classification in SWP_SOLIDSTATE so a changed/unregistered hibernation callback cannot unbalance nr_rotate_swap on swapoff; both callback sites remain. Native LTS atomic_long counter mask, reclaim cond_resched, rate-limited corrupt-entry diagnostics, encrypted-file rejection, percpu-reference shutdown and error unwinds remain. Host extracted-code checks cover header/map/cluster paths and hook classification; no real swap, extent, concurrency or runtime tests. Dual-signature ambiguity and the unchanged native bad-table bound are documented in SECURITY.md.

mm/mincore.c.rationale: Reviewed complete LTS/normalized-ACK deltas and syscall/do_mincore flow. Preserve emulated residency aggregation for the positive SDK page_shift=14 ABI. 5bc7751ba8de rounds requested length/result-vector count to userspace pages and carries OR state across native VMA/chunk boundaries. The old implementation could omit all bytes for short requests or one-native-page VMA chunks. Each successful result now covers every native subpage of the reported page. Native file_owner_or_capable/file_permission masking and page-walk locking remain; protected file mappings still produce conservative resident bits, preserving the LTS side-channel restriction. LTS non_swap_entry ordering before the disabled-SWAP warning also remains. Extracted syscall/aggregation host ASan/UBSan checks cover 240 length/split cases plus failures and old controls; they simulate walks/permissions and do not certify kernel concurrency.

mm/mlock.c.rationale: Full LTS delta is page-size header integration and emulated alignment for mlock/munlock entry ranges. Preserve RLIMIT_MEMLOCK and locked_vm accounting in actual native page units, CAP_IPC_LOCK checks, writer locking, zero/wrapped-range validation and native population/error behavior. Caller ranges are aligned before the stronger internal assertions. Keep newer LTS zone_stat_mod_folio accounting and vma_modify_flags pointer update so merged sticky guard flags are retained. Bionic/Android receive the configured emulated page-size ABI; this does not enlarge locking authority or import historical KMI layouts. Native 4 KiB behavior is unchanged; no runtime locking test.

mm/mprotect.c.rationale: Full LTS delta changes only include dependencies, start-alignment validation and length rounding to the emulated page size. Preserve native pkey validation, VM_MAY access limits, map_deny_write_exec, architecture checks, security_file_mprotect, vm_ops callbacks and TLB/lock sequencing. Keep LTS vma_modify_flags pointer API so updated sticky flags survive merging. Padding handling stays in separately reviewed common VMA helpers. Positive page_shift=14 requires the corresponding syscall page granularity; native mode is unchanged. Diagnostic rate limiting is in c476769367dd. No runtime protection test claimed.

mm/msync.c.rationale: Reviewed complete file and LTS/normalized-ACK deltas. Retain emulated start validation and range rounding only. Native flag validation, locked-VMA MS_INVALIDATE rejection, unmapped-range reporting, shared-file requirement, file references while dropping mmap_lock and fsync error propagation remain. Native vm_pgoff still converts to byte offsets using PAGE_SHIFT because internal offsets stay in native units. This preserves the emulated userspace page-size ABI without changing LTS writeback authority or dirty tracking. No runtime I/O test.

mm/madvise.c.rationale: Reviewed complete LTS and normalized-ACK deltas and changed call-site/locking/cleanup flows. Retain reported-page alignment, Android linker padding hints, anon_vma_name source export, swapin/pageout/reclaim and syscall customization hooks. b39eeed468ef releases the acquired madvise lock on callback bypass, releases the caller-owned VMA-name reference on both paths and initializes callback result slots. A callback retaining a name must take its own reference. Focused extracted-code host ASan/UBSan checks reproduce both former leaks and cover normal/bypass/error cleanup; they do not execute kernel locks or modules. Keep native LTS sticky guard flags and anonymous-only anon_vma_prepare, pointer-based vma_modify_flags, khugepaged registration and file_owner_or_capable/file_permission pageout side-channel checks. Ordinary process_madvise retains flags/iovec/pidfd/ptrace/CAP_SYS_NICE validation. The retained restricted raw syscall hook precedes those checks and may replace the operation: trusted kernel callbacks must implement appropriate access/argument validation, not assume it already happened. Reclaim begin/end retain balanced private-context handoff even on walk error, and native TLB completion runs before return-error policy. Hooks change trusted module policy, not userspace authority by default; no consumer absence is used as an omission reason.

mm/mremap.c.rationale: Full LTS delta is page-size helper inclusion and reported-page alignment/rounding for old/new addresses and lengths. Reviewed check_mremap_params and mapping constraints: flag validity, TASK_SIZE bounds, MAYMOVE requirement, DONTUNMAP equal-length rule, nonoverlap and map-count headroom remain native. Native move accounting and LTS DONTUNMAP unfaulted-anonymous vm_pgoff reset and locked_vm accounting order remain. Internal offsets/accounting use actual base pages. This preserves the SDK page_shift=14 ABI without importing historical KMI or reverting the later LTS corrections. No runtime remapping test.

fs/proc/array.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta only includes page-size definitions and reports /proc/PID/stat RSS in emulated-page counts, matching the reported page-size ABI enabled by Goldfish page_shift=14. Rounding loses less than one reported-page fraction, as inherent in the integer page-count ABI. Keep native exec_update_lock around task stat, ptrace-sensitive field filtering and scoped stats seqlock; no access check is relaxed. This is ABI consistency, not proof that all consumers handle non-4-KiB units correctly: local Toybox ps.c has both a fixed <<2 RSS conversion and a sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) path, and ProcessCpuTracker does not establish an RSS consumer. No runtime proc concurrency or userspace utility correctness test.

fs/exec.c.rationale: Reviewed complete LTS/normalized-ACK deltas and dma_buf_begin_new_exec plus prior reviewed fd/fork/exit ownership. Retain reported-page stack alignment, task-name/binfmt success/failure hooks and GPL task-name source export. Transfer DMA-buf accounting after unshare_files; old_files is used only as an identity comparison, never dereferenced after unsharing. New task/files accounting owns independent references; acquire the new MM reference only after successful exec_mmap, while the old MM retains its existing teardown reference. Allocation failure is after the point of no return and follows native fatal-exec cleanup. Positive lmkd/libmeminfo DMA accounting consumers are documented in the prior DMA review. Keep LTS CLOEXEC closure before exec_update_lock/FUSE wait, POSIX timer cleanup immediately after de_thread, futex_exec_done after MM replacement and unsigned argument-copy-loop fix. Hooks are trusted module customization points and do not replace native credential/LSM installation. No runtime exec-race certification.

mm/vma_exec.c.rationale: Full delta is an initial stack VMA sized to the reported page size and 2b8ae3b1fce2 accounting correction. Keep native KSM setup, mmap writer locking, anonymous VMA flags and failure unwinding; account vma_pages(vma), not one, in native stack_vm/total_vm units. Host extracted-function ASan/UBSan covers 4/8/16 KiB setup and each allocation/lock/KSM/insertion failure, with an old-source undercount control. No real exec test.

mm/mseal.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta only applies reported-page start alignment and range rounding. Retain flags/overflow/empty-range validation, mmap writer locking, no-unmapped-gap precheck and irreversible VM_SEALED behavior. Keep LTS pointer-based vma_modify_flags and sticky flag preservation. Positive page_shift=14 requires corresponding ABI granularity. No GrapheneOS hardening series or runtime sealing test added.

mm/util.c.rationale: Reviewed full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas and randomization/mmap paths. Retain reported-page randomize_page alignment, final mmap observation hook (scalar result, after native LSM/fsnotify/locking/unmap/population flow) and get_cmdline source export. 2b8ae3b1fce2 aligns random stack offsets within the native byte span so x86 stack_maxrandom_size reservation remains sufficient; 16 KiB placement has two fewer bits, explicitly documented in SECURITY.md. Remove obsolete __GENSYMS__ guard, not any actual source API. Keep LTS snapshot_page third-page copy bound nr_pages > 2. Host checks exhaust 12,589,056 x86 mask inputs; no runtime random-number/ASLR test. All current x86 randomize_page callers use ranges larger than page alignment; no generic range-underflow fix is asserted.

arch/x86/mm/mmap.c.rationale: Full net delta is helper inclusion and arch_rnd using reported-page shift. Preserve native PF_RANDOMIZE behavior, legacy/top-down choice, mmap minimum gap and task-size clamps. Existing emulated mmap_rnd_bits adjustment preserves byte span with two fewer bits at 16 KiB, documented as a security tradeoff. 2b8ae3b1fce2 separately aligns randomize_stack_top within native stack_maxrandom_size span, preserving the guard-gap reservation relationship; native 4 KiB behavior stays exact.

arch/x86/kernel/process.c.rationale: Only net delta changes stack subpage randomization from 8192 bytes to twice the reported page size, plus the header. Native ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE/randomize_va_space gates and final 16-byte alignment remain. Both 4 KiB and 16 KiB modes retain two reported pages of low stack displacement; setup_arg_pages performs separately reviewed page alignment. Other native x86 process and idle behavior remains LTS.

arch/x86/include/asm/elf.h.rationale: Only net delta defines ELF_EXEC_PAGESIZE as reported __PAGE_SIZE plus its include. This feeds the ELF loader and AT_PAGESZ ABI required by the local Goldfish 16 KiB command line. Retain native architecture compatibility, register layouts and personality checks. No historical KMI field preservation. fs/binfmt_elf.c dynamic min_coredump initialization was separately reviewed.

arch/x86/entry/vsyscall/vsyscall_64.c.rationale: Full delta includes the page-size header and expands the synthetic gate VMA end to the 16 KiB maximum so its reported span fits emulated-page granularity. This also makes the synthetic VMA larger in native 4 KiB mode; actual page tables, address-to-vsyscall-number validation, SIGSEGV paths and in_gate_area_no_mm retain native 4 KiB behavior. Actual SDK config selects XONLY, which installs no readable PTE for this pseudo mapping. No additional backing page is exposed and no runtime vsyscall test is claimed.

include/vdso/datapage.h.rationale: Reviewed full data-layout delta with x86 vma installation, lib/vdso/datastore.c fault insertion and linker symbols. x86 time/namespace/RNG/architecture areas are spaced at the 16 KiB maximum and expressed in native-page offsets; other architectures remain native. This permits the same compiled vDSO image in 4/8/16 KiB userspace modes. 745944398038 adapts the namespace reader in lib/vdso/gettimeofday.c to the declared offset rather than a hard-coded one native page; host extracted fault/lookup checks prove layout agreement and reproduce the old SIGBUS path. Current SDK TIME_NS is disabled, but the minimal shared-layout correction preserves native code under source/config customization; it enables no new platform or feature. Native PFN/readonly/sealed-system-map enforcement stays in datastore.c. No actual vDSO/time namespace execution test.

arch/x86/include/asm/vdso/vsyscall.h.rationale: Full delta scales reserved vDSO and virtual-clock areas and Hyper-V page offset by the native-pages-per-16-KiB ratio. Cross-checked linker symbols against vma.c fault/install offsets and include/vdso/datapage.h. Internal physical page units stay PAGE_SIZE; exported areas have reported-page-compatible boundaries. Native vvar fault checks and mapping permissions remain. This is compile-time common-image spacing, so native 4 KiB mode also reserves the larger range. No runtime virtual clock certification.

arch/x86/entry/vdso/vdso2c.h.rationale: Full delta rounds generated raw vDSO image size and backing-array alignment to 16384. This host generator cannot use a boot-time page-size variable; its constant matches __MAX_PAGE_SIZE. Both 32-bit compat and 64-bit images retain native ELF validation and copying with the larger initialized array. Actual SDK config has IA32_EMULATION=y. The change supports a single compiled image across page modes; no added platform or runtime test.

lib/vdso/gettimeofday.c.rationale: 745944398038 changes only the time-namespace real-data pointer increment to VDSO_TIMENS_PAGE_OFFSET * PAGE_SIZE. It equals native PAGE_SIZE on ordinary layouts and the actual kernel vvar insertion offset on x86 max-page spacing. Host checks run extracted lookup and fault code for native and x86 layouts with time-namespace enabled/disabled and insertion failure; old offset reaches SIGBUS padding on x86. Current SDK configuration keeps TIME_NS disabled. Clock arithmetic, sequence checks and syscall fallback remain native LTS.

fs/proc/page.c.rationale: Full LTS delta retains PG_error reporting needed by configured incfs source SetPageError paths and suppresses PFN-indexed proc APIs only when page-size emulation is active. Positive local libmeminfo/pageacct.cpp explicitly detects x86 non-4-KiB pages, skips opening these files and returns zero flags/one mapcount rather than consuming an invented PFN. ACK 6acc26714c0e documents physically noncontiguous native subpages, so a synthetic single PFN cannot preserve this ABI; retain that explicit SDK limitation, not an absence-of-consumer rationale. Native 4 KiB proc APIs and permissions stay; retain LTS exact FOLIO_MAPPING_FLAGS KSM classification fix. Other applications needing exact PFNs in emulated mode remain unsupported by this representation; no runtime test.

mm/page_idle.c.rationale: Reviewed full file/net deltas. Keep ACK 05fd7cf26c48 always-trylock before rmap_walk to support its UFFDIO_MOVE fine-grained folio-lock contract; failures remain best effort and never block on the lock. Native mapped/LRU/refcount checks, PFN bounds, mmu_notifier clearing and permissions remain. Suppress idle-PFN bitmap only in emulated page-size mode, matching libmeminfo/pageacct.cpp explicit non-4-KiB detection and IsPageIdle fallback. Its MarkPageIdle/GetPageIdle helpers require initialized actual PFN mode; no synthetic-PFN design is added. Native 4 KiB mode retains bitmap. The full multi-file UFFD series is separately reviewed; no kernel locking or bitmap runtime test.

mm/vmstat.c.rationale: Full net delta adds a pagetypeinfo output hook and scales zoneinfo watermarks/reserves/capacity/pageset counts to reported-page units. Pinned lmkd.cpp meminfo_parse_line divides kB by page_k and calc_zone_watermarks sums protection/high/low/min; these must use matching reported units. Preserve native per-node/zone event counters and /proc/vmstat in actual page/event units: lmkd refault ratios compare counters from that same source. This intentionally retains ACK mixed diagnostic units, not a claim that every zoneinfo field was converted. Local lmkd parses nr_free_pages/nr_free_cma and node active/inactive fields but does not use those zoneinfo copies in watermark policy. Other generic diagnostic interpretation is not certified. Kernel internal accounting and native locks unchanged; no runtime pressure/LMK test.

mm/cma.c.rationale: Retain Android CMA exports, retry/timing/bypass/bitmap hooks and GCMA selection for existing configuration and vendor source interfaces. Preserve native multi-range bitmap accounting, contiguous struct-page range checks, zones validation and LTS activation-failure cleanup across all ranges. 57131aee4cb9 checks optional CMA pointers before GCMA fields, preserves native folio GFP flags including __GFP_COMP, saves/restores incoming IRQ state and permits retry sleeping only with direct reclaim. Callback modules must obey bitmap bounds/alignment, ownership, accounting and context; bypass is trusted kernel policy. Actual SDK CMA/GCMA are enabled with CMA_AREAS=16, default reserved size zero, HUGETLBFS disabled. No new physical platform or reserved pool is enabled. Exact runtime GCMA pool provisioning remains unconfirmed and is recorded separately; configuration/source compatibility is the conservative retention basis. Host extracted allocator checks cover negative controls and atomic/native contracts; no runtime allocator test.

mm/cma.h.rationale: Retain GCMA selection and Android vendor/OEM scratch fields used by generic allocation hooks. These are source customization state, not a promise of historical offsets or CRCs. Keep native LTS multi-range, NUMA and accounting layout; cma activation initializes vendor state. Actual SDK enables CMA and OEM data.

include/linux/cma.h.rationale: Retain exported __cma_alloc with GFP argument and gcma selection on reserved-area initialization. Native cma_alloc_folio and other LTS interfaces remain. In-tree constructors explicitly pass false for ordinary/multi-range pools, while existing DT initialization propagates its GCMA property. 57131aee4cb9 restores acceptance of native folio GFP flags; no historical binary signature is preserved.

mm/cma_sysfs.c.rationale: Only net addition is readonly gcma attribute reporting each CMA area selection. Native statistics, lifetime, group creation and failure cleanup remain. This supports the enabled Android allocator configuration and exposes no pointers or mutation API.

mm/gcma.c.rationale: Full added backend reviewed: reserved-area allocation/free, cache key/inode hash, XArray page ownership, eviction, stats and cleancache operations. Keep generic Android GCMA source/configuration support conservatively; runtime SDK reserved-pool provisioning is unconfirmed, not inferred from BTF type declarations. 57131aee4cb9 uses reclaim permission instead of exact GFP_ATOMIC comparison and drains unmount inodes by taking references under the hash lock before acquiring page locks. This preserves pages-to-hash lock order and prevents background eviction from invalidating an unprotected hash iterator. Cache pages have XArray/temporary refs, inodes have linked-hash and operation refs, freeing uses RCU; after drain, workers cannot find removed pages and final inode freeing does not access gcma_fs. Existing built-in backend rejects missing areas or a different native PAGE_SIZE. Area registration must precede use and receive valid reserved, aligned memory; free requires exclusive caller ownership. No backend runtime race test; host simulated eviction/IRQ/ref checks and limitations are in SECURITY.md.

include/linux/gcma.h.rationale: Retain GCMA reservation/allocation/free and readonly statistics interfaces with disabled-config stubs. The reserved-page/exclusive-ownership contract is functional for mm/cma.c integration, not historical KMI. Inputs are trusted kernel callers, not a userspace physical-memory allocation API. No future platform is enabled.

mm/gcma_sysfs.c.rationale: Retain readonly atomic counters for allocated/stored/loaded/evicted/cached/discarded/total native pages and exported gcma_stat_get. The static object is installed under mm_kobj; no userspace write API or pointer exposure is introduced. Counter enum indexes are a trusted in-kernel contract. Actual GCMA_SYSFS=y; no runtime consumer or nonzero pool is asserted.

mm/gcma_sysfs.h.rationale: Internal declarations and disabled-config no-op accounting match gcma.c and readonly GCMA sysfs implementation. Retain enabled Android configuration support; no native LTS implementation is replaced.

mm/cleancache.c.rationale: Full added frontend reviewed: a single cmpxchg-published permanent backend, active-superblock initialization, negative disabled pool IDs, zero-initialized inode/export-filehandle keys, native PAGE_SIZE copies and page/inode/fs invalidation. Retain configured Android cleancache with GCMA/CMA and ext4/F2FS lifecycle consumers. Backend registration has no unregister API: operation storage/code must remain resident; supplied backend is built-in. Debug counters are approximate information, not security/accounting state. Native LTS filesystem permission/verity checks remain, with cache-hit verification in 1e4401eda113. b1ae0b82acce corrects wrapper invalidation for large folios; no actual cache I/O validation is claimed.

include/linux/cleancache.h.rationale: Keep source operations, negative pool states and disabled-config wrappers. Large folios remain excluded from base-page cache get/put storage. b1ae0b82acce invalidates the inode when putting or invalidating a compound folio so older base-page entries cannot survive replacement and return stale contents. This conservative fallback can reduce cache hit rate; it preserves coherence and uses the supplied mapping on invalidation when page->mapping is null. Focused extracted-wrapper host checks reproduce the previous stale put/invalidate results and verify ordinary/disabled paths.

fs/super.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK deltas reviewed. Initialize cleancache_poolid to disabled and invalidate before final filesystem shutdown; generic put_super hook runs while sb remains valid. Retain Android filesystem-only export namespace for source module infrastructure, with no binary KMI promise. Preserve native LTS passive-reference filesystem lifetime, SB_DEAD checks under sb_lock, mount delegation flags, emergency-thaw active references and lock order, remaining-freezer success and warnings. No LTS mount/namespace/security behavior is replaced by old ACK code; GCMA backend teardown is separately fixed in 57131aee4cb9.

mm/truncate.c.rationale: Full deltas and partial-folio/range paths reviewed. Retain cleancache invalidation even when page cache is empty, after partial zeroing, and after range invalidation; b1ae0b82acce handles old base-page entries beneath compound folios. Preserve native split-or-unmap SIGBUS handling, dirty/writeback and DAX ordering. Vendor split-result and advisory pagevec-skip hooks remain for source customization; callbacks must report actual split state and must not claim success if native unmapping is still needed. The skip affects advisory mapping_try_invalidate, not mandatory truncate/invalidate_inode_pages2. Default no-listener behavior remains native plus cache coherence.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem.rs.rationale: Retain the Android ashmem device and memfd ioctl compatibility for positive local libcutils consumers: memfd selection depends on property, policy capability, vendor API and application target SDK, so older applications still require ashmem. Full implementation reviewed: per-file mutex, immutable backing size after mmap, name bounds/termination, monotonic protection masks, VMA MAY permission checks, fixed-width pin ranges with checked bounds, CAP_SYS_ADMIN purge, compat inode width, fdinfo and referenced backing-file export. 9c710998db9a sizes all legacy pin commands from struct ashmem_pin because GET_PIN_STATUS encodes zero size; the preceding C implementation copies sizeof(pin) regardless of encoding. Memfd compatibility remains separately no-op for pinning and uses native memfd_fcntl sealing, retaining FMODE_WRITE, seal and inode-lock checks. User-space libcutils verifies GROW/SHRINK seals for memfd validity; the compatibility ioctls do not establish validity of arbitrary fds. Page-emulated mmap alignment is retained; shared EOF-tail questions remain separately recorded, not claimed resolved. Host dispatch checks use actual UAPI constants, not a kernel ioctl test.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem_toggle.rs.rationale: Retain enabled shrinker control and optional read/exec transition controls (ignore flags initially false). 9c710998db9a uses the existing iterator helper for short reads and actual copied-byte counts. 3ea7a304b5dc requires CAP_SYS_ADMIN before control writes: local ueventd /dev/ashmem* 0666 and SELinux /dev/ashmem(.*)? labeling also match these global devices, with write/open permissions for allowed ashmem client domains. Default miscdevice mode alone is insufficient under that userspace policy. This closes unprivileged global reclaim/protection-policy changes while retaining administrative controls and ordinary ashmem access; no Android policy modification or GrapheneOS kernel patch is imported. Extracted Rust checks reproduce the prior unprivileged write and short-read mismatch; actual SELinux/runtime execution not performed.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem_range.rs.rationale: Full added range/LRU implementation reviewed. Keep sorted disjoint unpinned ranges, reference-owned dual list links, one preallocated split/merge range, purge status, global mutex-protected transitions and atomic advisory count. Contiguous pin operations need at most one split allocation. File references survive shrinker operations; Area destruction removes its LRU links under the global guard. Shrinker uses try_lock and refuses filesystem-disallowed reclaim, holds pin/unpin exclusion through hole punching and yields to waiting pin callers. Toggle serialization owns shrinker registration and destruction. Existing randomized in-kernel test was read but not run; no runtime range/reclaim validation is claimed.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem_shrinker..rationale: Full local Rust shrinker wrapper reviewed: allocation/register ownership transfer, callback/private-data borrowing, bounded count/scan encodings, GFP filesystem/IO permission access and registration destructor. Native LTS shrinker_free waits for callback completion before returning and schedules only structural freeing through RCU, so dropping private data afterwards is valid. This is internal support for configured ashmem, not a new binary interface; no native shrinker implementation is replaced.

drivers/staging/android/shmem.rs.rationale: Full ashmem backing-file wrapper reviewed: ARef file ownership, native shmem_file_setup, private inode lockdep class, synchronized one-time immutable copied file operations, and referenced VMA file replacement. Direct backing-file mmap rejects EPERM; get_unmapped_area uses native mm_get_unmapped_area. Reads/seeks retain their caller synchronization contract; hole punching is serialized by ashmem range mutex. Dentry-name snapshot is pinned, bounded by its recorded length and released by pinned destructor. Keep native shmem/seal/security handling elsewhere; shared EOF-tail compatibility remains separate. No runtime backing-file I/O test.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem.h.rationale: Retain source declarations/exports, fixed legacy compat ioctl encodings and shrinker binding constants for the actual Rust ashmem build. Native 32-bit GET_FILE_ID writes u32 and native-width path writes usize; GET_PIN_STATUS payload is two u32 values despite size-zero command encoding. No historical vendor layout/CRC preservation.

drivers/staging/android/ashmem_exports.c.rationale: Retain four GPL exports for Rust ashmem symbols used by rebuilt modules: identity, name, size and backing file. The backing-file accessor increments its reference and requires the caller to fput; the source wrapper checks identity and locks per-file data. The C export list is necessary because this build only auto-exports Rust crates under rust/. No existing vendor binary compatibility is promised.

drivers/staging/android/uapi/ashmem.h.rationale: Preserve Android ashmem ioctl numbers and fixed two-u32 pin payload used by libcutils/bionic. This is userspace ABI, not excluded historical vendor KMI. GET_PIN_STATUS deliberately keeps its legacy size-zero encoding; adapt its reader rather than changing the ioctl number. Positive local bionic UAPI and historical C ashmem sizeof(pin) reader establish the contract.

drivers/staging/android/Kconfig.rationale: Retain ASHMEM as a bool requiring SHMEM and RUST, matching the actual SDK enabled ashmem implementation and positive libcutils older-app fallback. This builds in the Rust driver; no unloadable global-lock/module lifetime is introduced and no future device is enabled.

drivers/staging/android/Makefile.rationale: Retain CONFIG_ASHMEM selection of the Rust ashmem object and its C export bridge with local include path. Actual unchanged emulator build compiles this implementation; it does not run an ashmem client or OS.

mm/readahead.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed together with filemap/pagemap and every page_cache_ra_unbounded caller. Retain source-vendor allocation/GFP/retry/window/bypass/statistics hooks and OEM per-request storage; default callbacks leave native policy. Callback modules must preserve allocation-order limits, valid nonzero windows, execution context and forward progress; restricted forced-RA bypass must perform its own valid operation. Android forced-prefetch PG_oem_reserved_5 marking retains referenced-folio lookup and the existing MGLRU policy; related vmscan policy commits still require their independent review. 05ae9392c7c8 supplies a reference around the existing-folio callback and restores the new invalidate-lock contract in native ext4/F2FS callers. Bound-aware reads clamp to EOF/request max and suppress terminal async markers. Optional VMA boundary control is default off; ordinary read callers use ULONG_MAX. Native folio minimum-order alignment may span a boundary at granularity of a mandatory folio. No change to native filesystem permission checks or page-cache access authority. Extracted caller/lifetime tests and mmap-boundary tests cover adaptations, not real I/O/concurrency.

include/linux/pagemap.h.rationale: Full native and normalized deltas reviewed. Keep generic mapping-shrinkability and non-NUMA allocation-failure hooks, outlined readahead GFP hook, OEM request storage and functional max-index field. Restricted shrinkability overrides must obey inode/page-cache lifetime invariants; trusted callback safety is not supplied by an ABI guarantee. DEFINE_READAHEAD initializes max to ULONG_MAX; a complete local C/header search found no other aggregate initializer for this type. Native cache lookup/folio ownership helpers otherwise remain. No historical binary layout contract is retained; the new field is functional.

mm/vma_readahead_boundary.c.rationale: Retain default-off Android generic VMA-boundary runtime control, not tied to a future platform. Full implementation reviewed: kstrtobool rejects malformed input, __ATTR_RW limits writes to owner/root, static-key enable/disable is the native synchronized API, sysfs initialization reports failure. Full local ACK 266191fa3abd and fa6d5fcc3926 patches explain performance/memory intent. Searches of local GrapheneOS system, bionic and goldfish did not establish a runtime writer; this is uncertainty and not a reason for omission. Conservatively preserve optional runtime/configuration compatibility. No access-control override or new platform enabled; no benchmark/runtime claim; source-message links were not visited.

include/linux/vma_readahead_boundary.h.rationale: Retain static-key declaration and inline query for the default-off generic Android readahead control. Reviewed with complete implementation, build integration and both mmap callers. 15bccdfefe6d skips padding faults before calculating lengths/limits without removing the control. Native 4 KiB VMA boundaries and ordinary read behavior remain; no KMI-only content.

fs/proc/task_mmu.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed with page-size helpers, native pagewalk/mmap/VMA reference paths and positive local libmeminfo/bionic consumers. Keep Android statm units, ELF data/padding display, per-VMA smaps/numa/rollup iteration and statistics hooks. Original VMA remains locked while display padding is copied; data uses the real VMA. RCU is dropped around sleeping walks and iterator reset follows reacquisition, with mmap-lock fallback and gate skip. Native COW shmem accounting is retained with VM_MAYWRITE-aware refinement; partial ranges never use full inode swap totals. 20730118bf05 prevents whole-PMD double counting across displayed data/padding, retaining migration-safe native PSS and full-PMD fast path. d65b1b963b41 makes all pagemap read/seek offsets consistent and 110e353eded3 retains native WP/guard status in aggregates. ACK PFN/swap identities are intentionally suppressed under emulation because a single entry cannot encode noncontiguous pages; local PFN fallback and real swap-offset consumers were examined. This is a documented known lossy ACK interface, not a missing-consumer justification. Any-subpage present/exclusive flags are not a per-subpage/whole-group ownership guarantee. Native 4 KiB behavior and native LTS PMD absence, guard flag, THP pagemap, userfaultfd/hugetlb scan-write-protection and file ptrace/CAP_SYS_ADMIN checks remain. Callback statistics are trusted-module additions with live mm/seq/counter inputs. Host extracted reader/range/PMD checks passed, but no real kernel concurrency, procfs syscall or runtime SDK verification occurred.

mm/filemap.c.rationale: Complete LTS-to-port and normalized-ACK-to-port deltas reviewed with native folio/reference/lock callers and local Android ELF/page-size consumers. Retain generic Android allocation, memcg, cache/readahead, I/O statistics, locking and mapping callbacks and source exports; they operate on live references and preserve default behavior without registered trusted modules. Restricted allocation callbacks must honor native order/context and ordinary callbacks must not sleep under page-table/XArray locks or retain unowned pointers. The lock-drop callbacks explicitly receive fpin; a dropped fault lock means the VMA is unavailable. 8d75f9fa7f08 passes NULL after that drop, pins the unlocked mapped-folio callback, and snapshots index before write_end can free the folio. 15bccdfefe6d skips prefetch for all-padding VMAs and snapshots data bounds before unlock, preventing unsigned executable-window underflow; host extracted checks cover old-source failures. Cleancache uses b1ae0b82acce large-folio invalidation to avoid stale base-page cache data. Keep native xas_nomem original-order reset, mapped-folio dropbehind protection and file_owner_or_capable cachestat authorization. Cachestat units follow Android emulation while native permission checks remain. 7f9fdddd5bf8 fixes EOF snapshot/ref cleanup; shared EOF-tail semantics remain specifically provisional under b3c77090341c and are not certified by this path review. Large-folio mapping granularity is byte-identical to both inputs as separately recorded. This review covers generic Android source/configuration compatibility, not historical module binary layout. Successful workflow and focused host checks do not verify real page faults, concurrency or runtime SDK behavior.

mm/shmem.c.rationale: Complete LTS-to-port and normalized-ACK-to-port deltas reviewed with shmem allocation/swap/cache callers, Rust ashmem, native memfd flags/seals and local Android libcutils consumers. Keep the memfd-only ashmem ioctl gate (SHMEM_FL_MEMFD), fixed-width compat dispatch and native seal enforcement. Generic Android accounting callbacks receive live mapping/folio state: XArray-locked deletion reports before clearing mapping, successful swap transitions report their actual page count. Allocation/order policy callbacks remain trusted source interfaces and must return referenced correctly sized folios/valid supported order masks; mempolicy references are released on both paths. Vendor inode state is initialized. THP-off guards retain build correctness; native forced-collapse handling that bypasses sysfs remains. reclaim_shmem_address_space is retained conservatively for generic vendor source compatibility; 69eb820a7f4c replaces unowned RCU XArray pointers with referenced folio batches, preserves isolation ownership, releases lookup refs before reclaim, reschedules outside RCU and saturates its int result. Existing host extracted checks cover reference/isolation failures and signed count bounds; actual configuration enables SHMEM/THP/ASHMEM. EOF size is read once in 7f9fdddd5bf8, but the separate shared EOF-tail question in b3c77090341c remains provisional with the native shared-anonymous guard restored in c75a4c447656. This path review cannot finalize that candidate. No kernel runtime or external resource was used. Scoped follow-up at 14b3570de295 changes only the synchronous swap-read/cacheless flag (and matching comment): use __SWP_READ_SYNCHRONOUS_IO so write-only devices use normal swapcache/async reads. Existing exclusivity, swap-device pin, memcg charge, folio cleanup and shared EOF/DMA exclusions remain. Full six-line source commit and extracted 387-case dispatch test reviewed; no broader path reclassification.

mm/memory.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed with fault/COW/swap/zap/folio insertion callers. Retain Android source exports, RSS trace export and default-no-op allocation/fault/swap policy hooks. Native VMA/PTE ownership, memcg charging, zeroing, pte_same rechecks, swap-device pins, exclusivity/UFFD protection and cleanup remain. Swap wait bypass still exits through owned-folio cleanup; start/done callbacks are paired when the swap cache pin was acquired, after clearing it on either exit. Trusted callbacks must preserve valid folio orders, VMA containment and protection bits; swapmem gather bypass takes responsibility for releasing exactly the skipped native entries and must tolerate unmaps outside the exit gather bracket. Keep CMA eligibility for movable swap-in allocations alongside Android explicit __GFP_CMA policy; no SDK reservation is assumed. Native LTS VM_COPY_ON_FORK/guard copying and absent/nonpresent PMD handling remain. 623c51beadea restores exact LTS __vm_map_pages: ACK lock batching has no required ABI effect. Padding fault-around skip/clamp preserves common native/ACK larger-folio mapping granularity. VM_FAULT_NEED_ANONPAGE is handled after private COW cleanup and preallocated page tables are released; shared EOF-tail compatibility remains provisional with the native shared-anonymous guard restored. This scope explicitly excludes b3c77090341c and predecessor EOF extension candidates. No runtime faults/concurrency tested. Scoped follow-up at 14b3570de295 changes only the synchronous swap-read/cacheless flag (and matching comment): use __SWP_READ_SYNCHRONOUS_IO so write-only devices use normal swapcache/async reads. Existing exclusivity, swap-device pin, memcg charge, folio cleanup and shared EOF/DMA exclusions remain. Full six-line source commit and extracted 387-case dispatch test reviewed; no broader path reclassification.

mm/mmap.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed with x86 address selection, page-size initialization, BPF ring classification, profiling notifiers, native security and VMA setup. Retain reported-page brk/mmap-hint/munmap lengths and alignment for the positively configured Goldfish page_shift=14 target. ASLR limits are writable only during boot then read-only; native-mode values remain and the documented emulation tradeoff preserves byte span with fewer aligned placements. BPF pgoff adjustment is limited to a genuine bpf_map_fops file with kernel/user ring map type; ordinary files retain offsets and all native bounds/permission/seal checks. Keep default-no-op mapping-count/swap teardown hooks and native trace/helper exports for source-built vendor customization. A gather bypass callback must itself release the native swap entries; default native release remains. Preserve native MAP_DROPPABLE EOPNOTSUPP, MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, mmap_min_addr/LSM, file access and mapping cleanup. The generic profile_munmap notifier has a separately reviewed blocking chain. VM_NO_REMAP_FILE_PAGES positively protects local wrapfd read-only VMAs from deprecated remap_file_pages restoring VM_MAYWRITE; its kernel check is retained. Related unresolved shared EOF-tail semantics are not certified by this path review. No real syscall or SDK runtime test performed.

include/linux/mm_types.h.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK header deltas reviewed. Keep mm_struct DMA-buf accounting pointer and initialized Android vendor storage for generic runtime/source customization; layout is rebuilt from native LTS, with no historical KMI padding. kernel/fork.c initializes the accounting pointer and vendor state and owns lifecycle references as separately reviewed. Preserve native softleaf_t alias and all native struct changes. The emulation-specific VM_FAULT_NEED_ANONPAGE bit is moved by 7f9fdddd5bf8 to unused 0x008000, outside HINDEX_MASK, and included in error/trace definitions so fault callers unwind before private-tail fallback. Its shared-tail behavior remains explicitly unresolved; b3c77090341c and predecessor EOF feature rows are excluded from scoped finalization. DMA-buf nonfatal OOM statistics limitations remain under cross-file review; this header alone does not claim those semantics correct.

include/linux/shmem_fs.h.rationale: Complete LTS and normalized-ACK deltas inspected. Retain source-visible Android vendor inode storage and SHMEM_FL_MEMFD marker. __shmem_get_inode explicitly initializes the vendor field beyond vfs_inode; inode flags start with only VM_NORESERVE, and memfd alloc_file marks shmem-backed memfds before publication. The marker is in internal flags, whereas user FS_IOC flags use separate fsflags and cannot create the marker. Existing internal flag consumers test VM_LOCKED/VM_NORESERVE masks; the chosen bit does not collide with those. The resulting shmem ioctl gate restricts ashmem compatibility to real memfds. Native quota/lifetime fields and source layout remain; no historical module binary promise.

mm/memfd.c.rationale: Complete LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed with shmem internal flags, security_inode_init_security_anon/SELinux handler and positive local libcutils/sepolicy. Set SHMEM_FL_MEMFD only for shmem memfds before publishing the file, enabling the ashmem compatibility ioctl gate without granting it to arbitrary tmpfs files or accessing hugetlb inode data as shmem. Invoke anonymous security initialization with the fixed internal [memfd] class name, not user-controlled file name; errors fput the newly allocated file and propagate. Local libcutils explicitly tests the memfd_class capability before selecting memfd, and Android policy defines memfd_file permissions. SELinux retains the policy-capability gate and creation authorization; full SELinux changes are independently reviewed. Keep native seals/noexec sanitization and the newer LTS ordering that applies implied SEAL_WRITE before mapping_deny_writable, preventing the old execute-seal bypass. No permission test on loaded Android policy or running kernel was executed.

include/linux/memfd.h.rationale: Complete LTS delta adds only MEMFD_ANON_NAME with the fixed [memfd] spelling used by the locally reviewed memfd anonymous-inode security initialization and SELinux class selection. Native declarations/seal helpers remain; this defines a runtime labeling contract consumed by Android memfd_class policy, not historical KMI.

mm/compaction.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK deltas, compaction entry/exit and free/isolated-list paths reviewed. Retain generic vendor zone/target/abort/cookie hooks, async node compaction source API and Android file-page target policy for configured CMA/COMPACTION; no runtime reserved pool is assumed. New async API traverses populated zones, checks fatal signal, reuses native compact_zone initialization/cleanup and requires a valid online nid from trusted caller. Native source-block ALLOC_CMA checks, whole-block fallback policy, capture_control zone/page ordering and failed free_pages_prepare exclusion remain. The file-page preference obeys existing ignore_block_suitable semantics and is not an absolute ban on every CMA migration; fast free-page selection uses MOVABLE lists. ab9389a3d802 initializes cookie/file-page count per zone and resets PSI bypass each work cycle; formerly completion-only hooks could observe uninitialized state and removed callbacks could leave persistent bypass. Actual SDK INIT_STACK_ALL_ZERO also zeroes automatic storage, but source defaults must not rely on that. Hooks can alter compaction policy but are trusted and must preserve ownership/list/lock contracts. No real compaction, fragmentation or hotplug test performed.

mm/migrate.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK deltas and complete batch cleanup reviewed. Keep native migration/isolation exports for rebuilt vendor modules plus statistics, policy and bypass hooks. Entry-wait start runs while the page-table lock still stabilizes the entry; end only uses copied scalar time/zone. Folio-state hooks run with native owned folios. Split bypass returns EBUSY through ordinary failure handling. Batch-break occurs after paired source/destination lists are populated and still performs TLB flush, move retries and undo; callbacks must supply a valid remaining count and preserve list ownership. ab9389a3d802 defaults the break count to zero before each callback. Migration batch size remains trusted policy and must be positive. A remove-migration-PTE bypass takes responsibility for the skipped operation, not a permission granted to userspace. Retain newer LTS enum ttu_flags/TTU_RMAP_LOCKED/TTU_USE_SHARED_ZEROPAGE semantics, PMD migration predicate and cond_resched_tasks_rcu_qs. Source selection only; no runtime migration or race test.

mm/gup.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized-ACK deltas reviewed with folio_is_longterm_pinnable, longterm migration and cleanup. Retain the generic source hook wrapper and failure notification. Native FOLL_PIN validation, pin bias accounting and folio isolation/drain logic remain, including newer LTS GUP_PIN_COUNTING_BIAS versus compound pincount handling. The longterm eligibility hook can explicitly override native CMA/movable/device/DAX exclusions; it is a trusted kernel policy contract requiring the callback to guarantee safe longterm ownership/migration behavior. Without an override all native exclusions remain. The failure notification occurs after migration cleanup: its pages array is diagnostic only, may contain cleared/unowned entries, and grants no live page pins; callbacks must not dereference it as owned pages. No consumer was inferred from the absence of SDK registrations; retain generic Android vendor source compatibility conservatively. No runtime GUP test.

mm/internal.h.rationale: Complete header deltas inspected with compaction and filemap callers. Retain the Android compact_control file-page counter, initialized/reset in ab9389a3d802, for the reviewed target policy. Keep native LTS capture_control zone/migratetype/request-order representation and newer capture API; do not restore ACK historical pointer layout. maybe_unlock_mmap_for_io adds a default-false trusted bypass while preserving the native first-retry/NOWAIT predicates, get_file before releasing the fault lock and reuse of an existing file pin. With no callback native lock-drop behavior is identical; an override keeps the lock held and cannot silently pretend it was dropped. Filemap callbacks after a real drop receive NULL VMA in 8d75f9fa7f08. Rebuilt source modules, not historical binary KMI.

include/linux/compaction.h.rationale: Full delta adds only the compact_node_async source declaration under CONFIG_COMPACTION, matching its reviewed implementation and actual enabled SDK configuration. Native LTS capture_control API and all existing declarations remain. Runtime async-node usage is unconfirmed; retain the generic Android vendor customization interface conservatively rather than assuming lack of a caller proves it unnecessary.

mm/memcontrol.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK deltas and allocator/iterator/charge/over-high paths reviewed. Keep generic vendor statistics exports, lruvec traversal and lifecycle/policy hooks. Traversal owns mem_cgroup_iter references, releases them on early stop and intentionally visits the global lruvec with NULL memcg when disabled; callbacks must obey native LRU locking. A charge-replacement hook must transfer the owned CSS reference and return a live memcg, preserving the later charge/get/put contract. 769c2a3ea3f5 removes only two ANDROID_GKI enum-visibility objects while retaining memcg_page_state; rebuilt source modules use native enum headers. Preserve deliberate ACK 6fd1bc1e14da PSI default: artificial memory.high throttling is not counted as global pressure, while actual reclaim/limits remain. Positive local lmkd init_mp_psi and libprocessgroup memory.high configuration substantiate this Android runtime policy; hook can opt back into PSI. Penalty/reclaim tuning is trusted module policy and may override the default delay cap/skip reclaim; memory.max/native authorization are unaffected. Reset reclaimed/skip state every retry in 769c2a3ea3f5 so removed callbacks resume native reclaim; extracted full-function checks cover stale-bypass failure controls, PSI pairs, delay cap and CSS cleanup. Preserve newer LTS internal rstat API, round-robin stock drain, OOM-victim charge bailout, try_charge slab path, v1 failcnt, NMI local/global statistics and changed-limit loop exits. No real memory-pressure/LMK or loaded-policy test.

include/linux/memcontrol.h.rationale: Full header delta adds generic OEM/vendor per-memcg state and the reviewed traversal declaration. mem_cgroup_alloc uses kmem_cache_zalloc on memcg_cachep, whose size is struct_size_t(struct mem_cgroup, nodeinfo, nr_node_ids), including the enlarged fixed portion and nodeinfo flexible array, so added fields are initialized; native nodeinfo layout follows rebuilt source definitions. Native fields, types and helpers remain. This is retained customization storage, not historical KMI padding or enum-marker ABI artifacts.

include/linux/mm_inline.h.rationale: Full LTS delta adds default-false Android LRU/MGLRU add/remove bypass hooks before the native operations. All native list/generation/statistics code remains for ordinary calls. A callback setting skip explicitly assumes responsibility for the corresponding list membership, flags and accounting under the existing LRU lock; returning true is a handled-operation signal, not evidence that the native action ran. Retain generic vendor memory policy compatibility with actual LRU_GEN support, without assuming any SDK callback consumer. No untrusted userspace interface or historical layout promise is added; no runtime LRU race tested.

mm/page_alloc.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas, allocation/free/PCP/drain/compaction/reclaim/contiguous callers reviewed. Retain generic Android allocation, watermarks, diagnostic and pool policy hooks, __GFP_CMA restricted redirect, CMA PCP lists, validated pcp_thp_order boot parameter and rebuilt module APIs. 38e13dcb4814 separates high-order CMA lists, preserves the original fallback pointer and excludes CMA from ordinary mobility-group relabeling. Host extracted selection tests cover CMA/THP configurations, all accepted high orders and old failures. 72565355d3de resets zone/retry policy, initializes reclaim progress and honors returned pages. Callbacks remain trusted: zone/order/batch changes must remain in bounds, returned pages must meet frozen/refcount/zeroing/memcg contracts, free/list bypasses take responsibility for skipped validation, initialization and accounting, and source isolation helpers require the native zone/LRU locking. __GFP_NORETRY contiguous requests use bounded async migration while preserving the native GFP validation and cleanup. prep/free_hpage_order preserve explicit order for noncompound pages; prep_compound_page remains separate. Native LTS capture-control lifetime, barriers, direct-compaction/reclaim order promotion, reclaim lockdep and UP-NMI deferred free remain. Page-pinner/free and memsize bookkeeping do not replace allocation checks; optional memsize accuracy remains separate and its multi-file candidates are not finalized here. Actual SDK enables CMA/GCMA with no configured fixed pool, so exact runtime pool use remains unconfirmed and conservatively retained. No running allocator/CMA concurrency test. Scoped follow-up 8e8cbee1ce28 removes only report-only memsize accounting from free_reserved_area, restoring that function to native LTS. All allocator, CMA PCP and callback fixes remain. Memsize selection is now final for this target as documented in SECURITY.md; the older note about pending report accuracy is superseded only for this omitted report. Native free/page poisoning and statistics are unchanged.

mm/vmscan.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK deltas and reclaim loops, MM walk lifetime, mapping removal, asynchronous list/ref ownership and module exports reviewed. Preserve generic Android scan/folio/memcg/slab/PSI policy hooks with native defaults. 72565355d3de scopes folio and memcg decisions to each iteration and applies the native no-progress stop to vendor MGLRU reclaim; 429 host extracted scan/protection/rotation cases pass. Retain ACK executable-file first-use and MADV_WILLNEED promotion (readahead sets and reclaim consumes PG_oem_reserved_5), offlined memcg pacing/rotation and root shrinker-first policy. Positive local libprocessgroup per-process cgroups and lmkd process_mrelease support the offlined-cgroup and mm_users decisions. mmgrab is acquired under the MM-list lock and dropped after mmap-locked walks, preserving mm_struct and its tree while allowing exit_mmap/reapers to run; exit_mmap serializes tree destruction with mmap write lock. Native LTS large-folio reference comparison, dirty/writeback handling, reclaim flag preservation and tasks-RCU progress remain. In __remove_mapping the keep callback runs after folio_ref_freeze and must restore the supplied reference count before keeping it; writeback/eviction bypasses must assume skipped list/reference obligations. MADV_PAGEOUT private begin/list/end callbacks must move/consume remaining folios and preserve context lifetime; default NULL private uses native putback. Hooks run under their existing locks/RCU and may intentionally override reclaim protections/PSI policy as trusted kernel code, not userspace authority. No actual pressure, fault, concurrent teardown or Android runtime test.

include/linux/mmzone.h.rationale: Full header delta reviewed with allocator, lruvec and node initialization. Retain source CMA migration type/list changes, generic vendor/OEM storage and source isolation declarations; omit historical binary layout promises. MIGRATE_FALLBACKS separates ordinary fallback/merge types from CMA, enum limits still cover all native types and the bitmap. 38e13dcb4814 adds a third high-order PCP list only for CMA/THP; all initialization/draining iterates NR_PCP_LISTS and pindex_to_order handles each high-order list. lruvec_init zeroes the entire structure; per-node memcg allocations use __GFP_ZERO and mm/numa.c alloc_node_data explicitly clears sizeof(pg_data_t), so new fields initialize with rebuilt structure sizes. The isolation APIs require caller locks and their existing bool/count return contracts. No historical KMI layout retention or future-platform controller added.

include/linux/mm.h.rationale: Full LTS/normalized-ACK header deltas reviewed against implementations. Keep page-size padding flag fixup and boot-time ASLR bounds as ro_after_init, page-pinner put observation, generic longterm-pin customization and reviewed reclaim/allocator source declarations. VM_NO_REMAP_FILE_PAGES has a positive Rust wrapfd consumer preventing remap_file_pages from restoring forbidden write capability. Native LTS VM_MAYBE_GUARD, atomic-set allowed-mask, sticky merge and fork copying protections stay intact; obsolete ACK huge-page declarations and old MM CID exit name do not override LTS. The put callback runs before the caller frees a last-reference page; longterm-pinnable override is trusted module policy requiring DMA/migration safety. Native seal/guard protection is not bypassed by padding fixup. Shared EOF-tail and DMA-buf lifecycle candidates remain explicitly excluded from this scope.

include/linux/gfp.h.rationale: Full delta reviewed with mm/mmzone.c and allocator. Retain out-of-line gfp_zone hook wrapper around native __gfp_zone validation and reclaim-parameter source APIs. Ordinary movable/reclaimable bit-to-type assertions remain. Remove only the now-invalid HIGHATOMIC numeric assertion because the CMA PCP enum changes that internal value; the combined MOVABLE|RECLAIMABLE input is still warned as invalid and is not a supported new allocation mode. Keep newer native LTS default_gfp macro and all native GFP zone masks/bounds. This is rebuilt source compatibility, not a binary GFP/KMI promise.

include/linux/gfp_types.h.rationale: Full delta adds conditional __GFP_CMA bit at the end of the native GFP bit enumeration, with zero stub when CMA is disabled. Native GFP flags including new object-extension behavior remain; no historical numeric bit layout restored. gfp_to_alloc_flags_cma requires movable type and explicit bit under restricted mode, while disabled restriction retains native general movable eligibility. Keep this Android allocation-policy source contract with actual CMA configuration; no userspace flag namespace or permission change.

include/linux/pageblock-flags.h.rationale: Full delta adds only the get_pfnblock_flags_mask declaration matching the wrapper/export in reviewed page_alloc.c. Native pageblock bitmap, migratetype/isolate masks and bounds remain. Caller must supply a page/PFN and valid mask under the existing synchronization contract; retain generic Android source introspection without binary layout preservation.

mm/mmzone.c.rationale: Full file and net deltas reviewed. Only Android change is the gfp_zone wrapper invoking the restricted flags hook then native __gfp_zone. The native zone table and invalid-zone check remain. Trusted callbacks must return valid GFP placement flags; unchanged default preserves native allocation decisions. lruvec_init explicitly zeroes full rebuilt structures, including Android state, before initializing locks/lists and MGLRU.

include/linux/page-flags.h.rationale: Full delta and originating patches reviewed. Restore PG_error and helpers for concrete retained IncFS read_folio error paths in fs/incfs/vfs.c; this is functional source compatibility, not solely KMI. Keep PG_has_hwpoisoned as a first-tail overlay at PG_error, while PageError operates on the head, preserving their separate storage domains. Native flag layout is rebuilt, including PG_waiters bit 7. OEM flags are source customization state; PG_oem_reserved_5 has concrete readahead/MGLRU producer and consumer for MADV_WILLNEED. Native LTS page validity/poison predicates and aggregate flag bounds remain; no existing vendor binary layout assumed.

mm/show_mem.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized ACK deltas reviewed. Retain generic diagnostic show_mem export and Android available/total/free/shared-memory policy hooks. si_mem_available keeps the native negative clamp after customization; sysinfo mem_unit and native accounting calculation remain. Local lmkd/libmeminfo consume memory statistics, but no particular SDK callback implementation is assumed. Hooks are trusted statistics adjustments and do not alter allocation permissions or actual page accounting.

mm/shrinker.c.rationale: Full deltas and count/scan/root/memcg/refcount paths reviewed. Keep generic count/bypass hooks and shrink_slab export. Count callbacks must preserve nonnegative object-count/SHRINK_EMPTY conventions; default-false bypass leaves native shrinker logic. Retain ACK fix releasing shrinker reference and clearing the bitmap when kmem-disabled reclaim skips slab shrinkers. Native LTS shrinker_mutex protection around info teardown, in-lock error cleanup, RCU/reference acquisition and root/non-root routing remain. Actual MGLRU root-first integration calls this same native routing. No runtime shrinker registration/removal race tested.

mm/swap.c.rationale: Full deltas, LRU batching, free cleanup and native lru_cache_disabled readers reviewed. Retain generic source exports and activation/lazyfree/direct-free hooks. Lazyfree handled signal requires callback list insertion/accounting under the native lock; direct-free callback takes over the skipped reference subtraction and must preserve ownership of any carried lruvec lock/IRQ flags. flags already initializes to zero; native hugetlb/device cleanup and memcg uncharge remain. 133e0283da81 restores exact native LTS lru_cache_disable increment-before-RCU/drain ordering and removes only the internal drain-skipping optimization from 816567b17866, retaining its two exports. This preserves cache exclusion for migration/CMA and prevents insertion during the synchronization window. No runtime race test.

mm/page_io.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas, swapcache/fault/shmem/zswap-writeback and reclaim callers reviewed. Retain Android I/O policy, timing, lock-owner observation, synchronous read replacement and bio-charge hooks. All timing-end callers retain a folio reference through submission; 14b3570de295 initializes independent timing cookies. Default-false read replacement leaves native full-folio bio setup, task reference, completion status and unlock unchanged; a trusted replacing callback must supply the full folio contents or error and perform completion/unlock, with the provided device-relative start-sector adjustment. Keep separate read/write capabilities for source customization; 14b3570de295 makes read dispatch and both cacheless callers test only the read bit. Ordinary swapon still sets both bits, and filesystem I/O keeps precedence. Extracted actual dispatch functions pass 387 flag/callback/early-completion/PSI-cleanup cases with host shims and UBSan, including the old write-only false match. Native write errors redirty/clear reclaim/end writeback and read errors leave folios not uptodate before unlocking. Native zeromap partial-folio failure, zswap failures, and PSI/delay cleanup remain. No actual block I/O, kernel PSI, fault race or callback execution tested.

mm/swap_state.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas and cache-add/delete/read/readahead callers reviewed. Retain generic swap_space, swap_cache_del_folio and read_swap_cache_async GPL source exports and free/cache-wait hooks. swap_cache_del_folio requires the native locked swapcache folio and retains XArray locking, swap-slot release and folio-reference subtraction; callers must not use the folio after dropping their own last reference. read_swap_cache_async returns an owned folio, issues I/O with a live caller reference and preserves memcg charge/swap-cache insertion cleanup. The wait hook count initializes once and skip resets each iteration; default retains native uninterruptible timeout, trusted skip may intentionally busy-wait and carries an availability cost. Free observation occurs before batched reference subtraction. Native LTS swapcache/large-folio/page-table code is unchanged apart from these reviewed additions; source compatibility is conservatively retained without inventing an SDK callback consumer. No live swap race or pressure test.

include/linux/swap.h.rationale: Complete header delta reviewed against page_io, swap_state, vmscan and kernel/power/swap.c. Separate read/write bit definitions retain the combined setter and do not change userspace swap flags; 14b3570de295 uses the read bit consistently in read and cacheless paths. Added reclaim_pages/__reclaim_pages and swap_cache_del_folio declarations match retained generic source APIs and their reviewed list/folio ownership. alloc_swapdev_block declaration matches the existing hibernation implementation/export and its callers; no hibernation platform enablement is added. Native LTS swap types, counts and layouts remain; no historical binary ABI layout retained.

mm/rmap.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized ACK deltas and all rmap_walk, rmap_walk_locked, folio_get_anon_vma and folio_lock_anon_vma_read callers reviewed. Retain ACK 05fd7cf26c48 together with UFFDIO_MOVE 8f8f7e4d811c: anonymous reverse walks now hold the folio lock, stabilizing mapping/index against moves across anon_vma roots. folio_referenced takes a nonblocking lock when the caller has not already locked; contention returns referenced rather than evicting the folio. DAMON/page-idle use trylock; memory failure takes the folio lock before anonymous process collection; native migration/splitting/mkclean/unmap paths already lock folios. The anon_vma RCU/refcount and root read-lock lifetime rules remain even though the mapping-change retry is no longer needed. Keep generic source folio_referenced export and bounded-context reference/map/unmap/migration observation hooks; trusted look-around callbacks can alter referenced counts. Native LTS release publication and assign-before-interval-tree visibility fixes, per-PTE nr_pages reset, hugetlb PTE readers and softleaf handling remain. 56b1b2fc24a3 removes duplicate hook include/indentation only here. Local ART mark_compact.cc MoveIoctl is positive user evidence. No running page-table/rmap race test.

mm/userfaultfd.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas reviewed with move_pages locking, batched PTE move and cleanup paths. Retain 8f8f7e4d811c fine-grained folio locking without anon_vma write-lock serialization, coupled to 05fd7cf26c48 all-walker folio locking. The first source folio is pinned under PTL, blocking lock retries drop mapped PTEs/RCU first; subsequent batched folios are trylocked under both PTLs. Exclusivity and no-large-folio requirements, stable source/destination PTE/PMD rechecks, post-clear DMA-pin recheck/rollback, native destination protection, soft-dirty marking and TLB flushing remain. Nonpresent/swap/migration and UFFD mode validation are unchanged. Preserve native LTS clearing err before an EAGAIN loop retry so a later termination does not return stale failure. mm/damon/ops-common.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta consists of always taking folio_trylock for both damon_folio_mkold and damon_folio_young before rmap_walk, releasing after the walk. Retain as an inseparable prerequisite of UFFDIO_MOVE folio-lock serialization, not as a new DAMON deployment requirement. mm/memory-failure.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta is the folio lock/unlock around collect_procs in kill_procs_now, required for the locked-anonymous-rmap contract in 05fd7cf26c48. Reviewed all collect_procs callers: normal and hugetlb hwpoison_user_mappings callers already hold the folio lock; the device-DAX caller uses dax_lock_folio and reaches file mappings, while private/coherent device pages are rejected. kill_procs_now is reached after a failed large-folio split with a live page reference and no retained folio lock. The added lock serializes mapping/index access with UFFDIO_MOVE; signaling follows unlock. Native LTS poison containment, failure cleanup and page-reference handling remain. No injected memory failure or hardware platform enablement.

mm/huge_memory.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta and all 1000-line normalized-ACK differences reviewed. Retain generic Android THP allocation/order/split policy hooks, mthp statistics and PMD lock source exports. 56b1b2fc24a3 completes only the PMD portion of 8f8f7e4d811c by removing redundant anon_vma write locking while keeping the folio lock and native LTS migration predicate/wait on actual src_pmd; all rmap walker prerequisites reviewed together. Native PMD exclusivity/DMA-pin post-clear rollback, page-table deposit, notifier and TLB handling remain. Native huge-zero publication/reclamation lock, deferred-split reference batches/queue locking, dirty PMD propagation, mapping unlock before dropping the last inode pin, compound preparation before hwpoison flags, memcg XArray charging, split eligibility and reference-freeze fixes are preserved. Extracted function comparison confirms native huge-zero and deferred-scan bodies and the exact PMD adaptation. Split policy is deny-only after native eligibility; bypass callbacks run with the native mapping/anon_vma read/write lock and memcg context and must perform valid complete splitting or report an error without violating folio/list/XArray ownership; native out_unlock restores context and frees preallocation. THP order callbacks must return supported orders; default no-op preserves native limits. Actual SDK enables THP; ART MoveIoctl is a positive runtime interface consumer. Only source review and emulator compilation, no runtime race/GC performance verification.

mm/memblock.c.rationale: 8e8cbee1ce28 omits memsize reporting and report-only counters for the current SDK target. Full ACK/LTS/port deltas, all counter readers and call sites, report registration gate and actual built configuration reviewed. Both procfs/debugfs registration are under CONFIG_DEBUG_FS && CONFIG_ARCH_KEEP_MEMBLOCK; the SDK has DEBUG_FS=y but no ARCH_KEEP_MEMBLOCK. Its only x86 selector is INTEL_TDX_HOST, a different host role not added for this guest. Thus changing memblock_memsize=procfs/debugfs cannot expose the report here. Counter values do not feed allocation, page release or native sysinfo. This is a positive compiled-target boundary, not a failed-consumer-search conclusion. Native LTS memory handling and diagnostics remain. Requested-size versus actual-reservation accounting, report mutation/concurrency and 64-KiB sampling are not certified for future targets; those diagnostics are absent. No architecture is enabled to make the report available. The only remaining delta is generic memblock_free and memblock_end_of_DRAM GPL exports guarded by ARCH_KEEP_MEMBLOCK, with both native bodies unchanged. Guarded exports preserve rebuilt source customization only while backing arrays remain valid; actual SDK discard may free arrays even with MEMORY_HOTPLUG retaining code/static data. Preserve native LTS allocation overflow/bounds, reservation merge/removal, flags, KHO and memory-release code exactly. Export free now follows its own definition; no behavioral change.

mm/process_vm_access.c.rationale: Complete LTS/normalized ACK deltas and process_vm_rw_core ownership paths reviewed.
