mm/oom_kill.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas plus signal/reaper callers reviewed. Retain generic OOM victim-selection/timing/diagnostic hooks, mark_victim trace export, dump_tasks export and opt-in add_to_oom_reaper for a successfully sent SIGKILL. kernel/signal.c invokes it only after native permission checking and successful delivery when the trusted callback requests reaping; find_lock_task_mm locks a live task mm, task_will_free_mem requires all sharing tasks to be dying, cmpxchg+mmgrab pins oom_mm once, and native queue flag/task reference/timer lifetime remains. Default-false thaw/reaper-delay controls preserve native behavior. Gather init/finish bracket native VMA reaping, including failed notifier paths; callbacks must own any custom swap cleanup. Local lmkd/reaper.cpp positively kills then uses process_mrelease; this is evidence for preserving memory-release behavior, not proof of a particular vendor hook consumer. Dump diagnostics use trylock in NMI and skip memcg traversal there; actual SDK NUMA=n makes cpuset eligibility a constant true. This is best-effort diagnostics, not a general proof of arbitrary NUMA/NMI callback safety. Native victim scoring/protection, mmap and task references, reap retries and process_mrelease checks remain. 7a6afb06646e removes a duplicate include only. No actual OOM or NMI test.

mm/vmalloc.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas and allocation/free/report contexts reviewed. Keep generic no-flush mapping exports, vmalloc_nr_pages diagnostic export, stack recording/report hooks and allocation/free replacement hooks. Defaults preserve all native validation/accounting; replacement allocation must supply an appropriately aligned, initialized, accounted mapping with a matching free implementation. vfree bypass executes before interrupt routing, NULL handling and native cleanup, so a replacing callback must handle those contexts/NULL and own permissions reset, TLB/unmap, memcg/kmemleak and reference cleanup. No-flush source callers remain responsible for native cache/TLB synchronization and mapping exclusivity. Timing start observes all attempts but end reports only success; callbacks must not assume an end event for failed allocation. Stack callbacks see live newly initialized vm_struct or hold the busy-tree lock in reporting. vm_struct allocation zeroes its full rebuilt size. Native LTS init_mm read-lock exclusion against ptdump during huge page-table replacement remains intact. Local libmeminfo reads vmallocinfo; hook-added formatting must preserve that parser contract. No runtime allocation/free race test.

include/linux/vmalloc.h.rationale: Complete delta adds the Android vendor include and OEM storage in vm_struct for generic stack/policy state, not historical layout padding. Actual allocators kzalloc_node(sizeof(*area)) and initialize fields before hooks. Native newer LTS is_vm_area_hugepages NULL check remains, avoiding dereferencing a missing area. mm/percpu.c.rationale: Full delta consists of GPL per_cpu_ptr_to_phys and MINIDUMP namespace pcpu_nr_pages exports with native function bodies unchanged. mm/page_ext.c.rationale: Full LTS and normalized ACK deltas reviewed. Register the retained optional PAGE_PINNER operations and export native page_ext_get/put in MINIDUMP namespace for generic diagnostics. Existing RCU read-side lifetime and NULL unwinding remain exactly native: successful get must be paired with put in the same context and data cannot be used after put. PAGE_EXTENSION/PAGE_PINNER are enabled in the SDK; previous page-pinner implementation/lifetime fixes remain. No hardware crash-dump platform is added; source diagnostics are retained conservatively.

mm/page_owner.c.rationale: Complete source/header delta reviewed. Expose get_page_owner_handle for generic MINIDUMP namespace diagnostics, with stackdepot type inclusion moved to the header. It returns zero before owner tracking is enabled or for a non-head-aligned PFN, then a READ_ONCE stack handle. Caller must hold a valid page_ext obtained under its RCU lifetime and treat allocation metadata as a best-effort concurrent snapshot; this does not pin an allocated object. Existing owner update/reset and stackdepot rules stay native. SDK enables PAGE_OWNER; no particular vendor dump consumer or runtime dump result assumed.

include/linux/page_owner.h.rationale: Full delta moves the stackdepot include to the shared declaration header and declares get_page_owner_handle only under CONFIG_PAGE_OWNER. It matches the reviewed implementation and does not promise availability with owner support disabled. Native page-owner APIs and types remain, with rebuilt module namespace/import obligations.

mm/zsmalloc.c.rationale: Full LTS/normalized ACK deltas, metadata allocation and migration lock contexts reviewed. Retain Android shrinker policy hooks with default-false bypass and zero-initialized count, and clear __GFP_CMA alongside HIGHMEM/MOVABLE for nonmovable slab metadata while allowing eligible zram data allocations elsewhere. Preserve ACK 76f4f81414fa reverse-order unlock (zspage, class, pool), matching acquisition/failure paths and protecting subordinate lock release until the outer lifetime lock is released. Native LTS lookup_size_class includes handle overhead consistently in both external lookup and allocation; do not restore the old undersized class lookup. Current SDK builds ZSMALLOC/ZRAM modules. Native isolated-page lifetime TODO is not claimed solved by unlock ordering. No live compression/migration/compaction or pressure test.

mm/khugepaged.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta is the MIGRATE_FALLBACKS squared reserve calculation, preserving three ordinary migration types after ACK adds a separate CMA PCP type. This keeps native pre-CMA reserve magnitude rather than inflating it for restricted CMA. All later native LTS guard/UFFD write-protection checks under PTL, write-open/invalidate/dirty-flush exclusion for file collapse, migration predicate and MADV_HUGEPAGE registration placement remain; normalized ACK differences were read in full. No runtime THP collapse test.

mm/slab.h.rationale: Full LTS/normalized ACK delta reviewed with SLUB implementation and cache creation. Move native slab flags, track types and __slab_clear_pfmemalloc into the internal header for rebuilt source customization; expose matching tracking/iteration declarations only with SLUB_DEBUG. OEM cache storage is zeroed by ordinary/boot cache allocation and static boot structures, not historical layout padding. kmalloc_slab default preserves native cache selection including KMALLOC_NO_OBJ_EXT recursion avoidance. A trusted replacement cache must satisfy requested index/size/alignment, usercopy, accounting and NO_OBJ_EXT constraints; arbitrary replacement is not certified safe. No native flag value or security check is replaced by a historical KMI workaround.

mm/slub.c.rationale: Complete LTS/normalized ACK deltas and debug iteration, allocation/free hooks and bootstrap/cache initialization reviewed. Retain generic slab source customization and diagnostic exports, including get_track and MINIDUMP iteration/info. get_track requires a live correctly sized tracking-enabled object; get_each_kmemcache_object holds node list lock with IRQs saved, balances metadata-access toggles and early-return unlocks, and visits slots (including free ones) in node partial/full lists, not a guaranteed complete/live-object snapshot of per-CPU caches. Callbacks must not sleep, allocate recursively from the same cache or retain pointers after unlock. Retain native LTS separate NO_OBJ_EXT caches/recursion fix, full-object initialization for later krealloc, CPU-hotplug lock for RCU-sheaf flush, cache-alias/usercopy checks and late sysfs/debugfs lifetime fixes. Large allocation replacement must obey frozen-folio/order ownership; large-free bypass occurs after native KASAN/kmemleak/profiling/memcg/large-kmalloc accounting and takes responsibility only for the remaining frozen page free. Hooks default to native behavior. 7a6afb06646e removes duplicate include. No runtime slab concurrency, allocation fault or vendor callback test.

mm/slab_common.c.rationale: Complete LTS delta adds only generic slabinfo header/row hooks; all normalized-ACK differences retain newer native LTS cache aliases, usercopy bounds, NO_OBJ_EXT setup and RCU-sheaf CPU lock. Hooks run inside native slabinfo iteration with a live cache and initialized slabinfo. Local libmeminfo/sysmeminfo.cpp requires slabinfo version 2.1 and exactly 16 row cells: default no-callback output remains native; callbacks that append columns would violate that Android reader contract and are not claimed compatible. Retain source customization while documenting this concrete constraint; no unrequested reader or OS modification.

include/linux/oom.h.rationale: Full delta declares the retained dump_tasks diagnostic export and add_to_oom_reaper helper for the reviewed signal/OOM integration. Native task/mm pointer and lock contracts remain; no new userspace privilege or historical KMI layout.

drivers/block/zram/zram_drv.c.rationale: Complete LTS-to-port and normalized-ACK deltas read, with full compressed writeback, prefetch, slot-free/replacement, completion, sysfs and I/O ownership paths. Retain compressed batched writeback and prefetch backing-copy cache: local mmd_setup.rs enables compressed_writeback, service.rs gates per-process operations on it, and per_process_ioctls.rs uses the range/prefetch/version ABI. Keep native LTS init read/write exclusion, write-side limit stores, 4-KiB budget rounding, locked slot-handle capture, synchronous partial writes, compressor reset on failed init and deflate bounds. 8e348642e1f0 propagates asynchronous request/bio allocation failure to native parent read-error handling; invalidates cached backing copies in every slot_free path (not only swap notify), preventing stale reuse after overwrite/discard; and uses a completion plus submission reference to join the last prefetch notifier before returning or dropping init_lock/pp_in_progress. Free request resources before completing. Original raw compressed page tail zeroing remains, preserving confidentiality on full-page backing writes. Native page/slot references and swap-level ownership protect normal fault reads; concurrent arbitrary raw-device overwrite is not promised an atomic snapshot. Slot metadata becomes u32 seconds/flags, retaining the big-endian lock-bit correction without claiming subsecond idle telemetry. Prefetch is best effort: deferred I/O/population failures do not report all missed hints to userspace. Process budget counts matching swap entries, not guaranteed successful writes; result bytes count completed physical writes and omit cache reuse. 35b41a30b529 uses native compat_ptr dispatch for identical ioctl layouts in the already-enabled IA32 configuration, preserving checks. 21 extracted-function error/cleanup cases and deterministic last-notifier interleaving checks pass with old-source controls; no actual I/O or memory-pressure race run.

drivers/block/zram/zram_drv.h.rationale: Complete LTS and normalized ACK header deltas read with implementation. Retain reduced slot flag/access-time metadata and ZRAM_ENTRY_LOCK_BIT mapping, writeback batching/compression/cache state, shared pp/wb control definitions and prototypes for ioctl implementation. Native size guard checks flags fit u32. Store actual initialized state for runtime features; no historical KMI padding. Cache records remain separate from actual RAM/zsmalloc ownership; lifecycle fixes in 8e348642e1f0 use existing declarations. WRITEBACK/MULTI_COMP/ANDROID_IOCTL guards and disabled cache stubs match compilation paths. No binary layout compatibility claim.

drivers/block/zram/zram_ioctl.c.rationale: Entire ioctl implementation, native mm/pagewalk/swap APIs and local mmd userspace/policy reviewed. Retain version 1, legacy writeback, bounded range writeback and process prefetch, guarded by device access plus global capable(CAP_SYS_NICE) for process operations. This intentionally uses get_task_mm rather than ptrace mm_access: current range API returns next_addr and byte counts, so old commit 4191645fc555 claim that no address metadata is exposed does not apply to the final ABI. Accept that privileged daemon metadata/performance authority for Android compatibility; do not claim unprivileged isolation from a SYS_NICE holder with device access. Local mmd.te permits only mmd for current ioctls and denies legacy to every domain. Native file owner/write check limits shared file pageout; pidfd/task/mm refs, mmap lock, PTE snapshot lock, swap device reference/type/non-swap and bounds checks remain. PTE snapshot can become stale before marking a slot, so selection is approximate; global post-processing exclusion and slot flags prevent old data replacing a newly written-back generation. 8e348642e1f0 initializes next_addr/written_bytes before all failures, including the legacy stack temporary; SDK stack initialization already mitigates uninitialized automatic data, and no ABI sizes or command values change. Actual driver functions pass 21 host-shim cases covering permission/init/busy/allocation/scan/write errors, output counts and cleanup; old controls reproduce failures. No live task page walk, swapoff or authorization test.

Keep legacy command 1 for kernel ABI compatibility despite current mmd SELinux prohibition. All structures begin with aligned_u64; compile-only assertions with host cc -m32 and -m64 confirm sizes 16/40/8, field offsets and all four ioctl numbers. 35b41a30b529 supplies native block compat pointer dispatch in configured IA32 mode, with no argument layout translation or permission bypass.
